bg.description: Page background behind every screen. Cards sit on it.

surface.description: Cards, sheets, menus, the sticky bars. The only fully opaque surface.

surface-2.description: Hover state for rows and cards on surface.

fill.description: System fill: text fields, segmented-control tracks, ghost buttons, inner panels inside a card.

ink.description: Primary text and icons on bg, surface and fill (16:1 on surface).

muted.description: Secondary text: hints, captions, metadata (4.9:1 on surface, 4.6:1 on bg).

line.description: Hairline separators between list rows and table rows. Never a box outline.

accent.description: The one brand colour: primary buttons, links, selected states, progress, focus. 5.6:1 on surface.

accent-ink.description: Text and icons on accent fills.

accent-soft.description: Tint behind a selected option, icon tiles, the focus ring.

card-cover.description: Second data hue: the card-insurance track in recovery splits. Use only beside accent in a chart.

ok.description: Eligible, verified, sent, settled. Text on ok-soft at caption size is 4.3:1, so keep it semibold.

ok-soft.description: Background of success pills and the weather-verified tile.

warn.description: Contestable amounts, deadlines inside 7 days, chargeback-ready.

warn-soft.description: Background of warning pills and the airport baggage notice.

bad.description: Errors, missing evidence, legal limits, deadlines inside 3 days, sign out.

bad-soft.description: Background of the Legal limit pill and live indicators.

info.description: Neutral status: Needs info, Airline must act, Claim sent.

info-soft.description: Background of info pills and instruction banners.

chrome.description: Translucent top bar; pair with a 20px backdrop blur. Falls back to bg with reduced transparency.

stage.description: Video consult stage. The only dark surface in the product.

display.description: One per screen: the hero headline or the recovery total. Scales down to 40px on phones.

title-2.description: Section titles above grouped cards, card headings.

headline.description: Row titles, amounts in lists, option names.

body.description: Default running text and form input text.

footnote.description: Explanations under a row, nav links, table cells.

caption.description: Legal citations, pill labels (semibold), table headers.

eyebrow.description: Uppercase context line above a page title. Colour muted.

mono.description: Times in weather tables, PNRs in corporate tables, pasted SMS text.

space-2.description: Gap between buttons in a row; between a heading and its card.

space-3.description: Gap between cards in a grid.

space-4.description: Page side gutter; list row vertical padding; field grid gap.

space-5.description: Inner padding of list rows and small cards.

space-10.description: Gap between grouped sections on a page.

space-20.description: Top padding of the landing hero.

radius-sm.description: Segments inside a segmented control, menu rows.

radius-md.description: Text fields, selects, icon tiles, inner list containers.

radius-lg.description: Option tiles, drop zone, inner panels inside a card, floating bars.

radius-pill.description: Buttons, pills, progress segments, the role switcher.

shadow-card.description: Resting cards on bg. Cards have no border.

shadow-raised.description: Menus, toasts and floating action bars above content.

content-narrow.description: Max width for forms, audit and payout screens.

content-wide.description: Max width for dashboards, landing and portals.

control-height.description: Minimum height of fields and primary buttons: Apple's touch target.
